ClientResponses.Response: It sounds like your grill was in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow the instructions in the provided link down below to reset the bypass safety mode. This is also the way you would want to start your grill each and every time. https://www.weber.com/US/en/blog/burning-questions/why-wont-your-gas-grill-get-hot-its-probably-in-bypass-mode/weber-29816.html
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Results.ReviewText:
Over the years, I have always bought a mid to top of the line grill from the big box stores, but I've always overlooked Weber.  They were just more than I was will to spend on a grill.  After my last relatively expensive grill rusted out after 2 years, I decided to bite the bullet and buy a Weber.  So far, this has proven to be a great decision.

The Weber grill was easy to assemble with great instructions.  Everything lined up perfectly and went together just like it should.  The grill cooks great.  I've never had a grill that didn't have hot spots, but the Weber cooks nice and even.  I couldn't be happier.  I just hope it lasts more than a few years.  Time will tell.
Results.Title: Lovin' my new Weber

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
